annotation.authors_or_issuer: African Union Commission, Directorate of Information and Communication
key_provisions_or_claims: AUCSEG advises the AU Commission on cybersecurity policy
Proposes solutions to ratify and domesticate the Malabo Convention
Supports CSIRT establishment and capacity building
Declares Africa must articulate its own philosophy, ethics, policy and accountability frameworks for cyberspace, cybersecurity and AI
Aims to develop continental strategies and action plans
annotation.summary_en: African Union press release on the first meeting of the AU Cybersecurity Expert Group in December 2019. It outlines the group's tasks, including advising the AU Commission, promoting Malabo Convention ratification, and CSIRT development. It declares Africa should articulate its own ethics and accountability frameworks for cyberspace, cybersecurity and AI.
annotation.title_clean: African Union Cybersecurity Expert Group holds its first inaugural meeting
